slide1.headline: Banks Warned of AI Security Risks
slide1.subtitle: Anthropic's Mythos AI poses threats

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 10 Apr 2026
Powell and Bessent warned banks about security risks from Anthropic's Mythos AI.
The warning was reported by Bloomberg.
No specific numbers were given, but the risks are considered significant.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The warning highlights the growing concern about AI security risks.
As AI models become more powerful, the potential risks also increase.
Banks and financial institutions must take steps to mitigate these risks.

slide1.headline: EU AI Act 2026
slide1.subtitle: Europe's defining moment for AI regulation

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: The EU AI Act 2026 is a significant development in AI regulation.
The act will provide a framework for the development and use of AI in Europe.
The regulation will impact companies with 7.8 million euros or more in annual revenue.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The EU AI Act 2026 will have a significant impact on the AI industry in Europe.
The regulation will provide a framework for the development and use of AI.
Companies must comply with the regulation to avoid penalties.
